# Get Started

This guide walks you through the basic steps to start building on Kaia.

## Step 1. Install a Wallet

Install a wallet such as Kaia Wallet or MetaMask to manage your accounts and sign transactions.

## Step 2. Connect to the Kaia Testnet

Add the Kaia testnet (Kairos) network details to your wallet so you can interact with testnet contracts and dApps.

## Step 3. Get Test KAIA

Request test KAIA from the [Kairos faucet](https://kairos.wallet.klaytn.foundation/faucet) to cover gas fees on the testnet.

Testnet KAIA has no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for real assets.

## Next Steps

Once you have test KAIA, you're ready to deploy and interact with smart contracts on Kaia.
